role.purpose: 补充厂商 Vulkan 驱动缺少或不适合当前应用的 Wayland surface/swapchain 窗口呈现支持
role.layer: 原生 Linux 用户态 Vulkan WSI 适配层
connects_from: Godot 原生 Vulkan 后端
connects_to: 系统 Vulkan ICD/GPU 驱动
Wayland compositor，通过 DMA-BUF 交换图像
not_a: 通用跨机型 Vulkan 软件实现

requires.memory_heap: system-uncached DMA-BUF heap; actual kernel device and permissions must be checked
requires.gpu: Existing working Vulkan ICD and the Wayland/DMA-BUF/external-memory/synchronization extensions required by this build; version numbers alone do not certify compatibility

patches.purpose: 旧 RK3566 g13 驱动的校准时间戳 EXT/KHR 接口适配
Wine runner 的逐启动首帧通知；未设置 WINE_RUNNER_PRESENT_TOKEN 时不写通知

integration.loading: App-private process-local layer; preserve system driver and app save locations
integration.godot_manifest_difference: Same ELF; app-only implicit enable flags and minimal interface declaration for older loader; substitute absolute library path at packaging/launch, never rename compiled layer identity
integration.activation: Do not place both manifests into one active layer search directory. Choose the adapter for the actual engine and firmware. Do not automatically enable from model/SoC name alone.
integration.reuse: Copy the verified binary and appropriate manifest into the selected runtime. No compiler or source rebuild for an unchanged compatible deployment.
integration.godot_template_device_validation: Derived from the working Emberward minimal manifest; enable/disable variable and path placeholder names normalized for reuse. This generic naming has not itself been deployed.

validation.target: MiniLoong LP4X RK3566/RK817, LoongOS Mali-G52 g13p0
validation.engine: PortMaster Godot 4.3, native Wayland, Vulkan Mobile
validation.scope: Hardware, runtime and GPU queries, Vulkan startup and payload hash were checked on this configuration. Other firmware and complete gameplay require separate validation.
Native presentation was checked in this environment. Compatibility varies by game and runtime.

rebuild_when: 源版本或二进制补丁变化
目标CPU架构改变，或需要兼容低于现有 glibc/libstdc++ 基线的系统
需要增加 X11/其他 WSI 后端，或必须更改 DMA-BUF 分配/驱动交互实现
实际缺少必要接口且无法仅靠加载清单或启动配置解决
no_rebuild_for: 仅更换 IP、设备名称、游戏内容或普通启动参数
新机型满足同一 ABI/图形接口要求并经验证
只调整加载清单或进程环境而不改变 ELF 实现
